caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white on a beige background and consists of several outlined shapes arranged within a rectangular border, labeled with alphanumeric codes such as D1, D2, D3, D4, D8, D9, D10, and D11. Each shape features notches, ducks, notations, and measurements along the edges and within the shapes. The upper area of the larger shapes is marked with sequential numbers and short, vertical lines, suggesting pleat or fold positions. Arrows and dashed lines appear on some of the patterns, indicating instructions or directionality. There is printed text at the bottom center and lower area, providing detailed construction notes which refer to the various labeled parts, such as bodice front, back, side, sleeve, petticoat, placket, belt, and skirt panels. The text also mentions loops, shirring, ties, and the assembly process, referencing where specific components sew together and how certain lines denote folds or pleats. The overall composition is technical, with the shapes presented directly and minimal embellishment aside from the labeling, numbers, and instructional text.
title: Dress (Pattern)
